title: Membership of a left-summand index
statement: For natural numbers $k,m$ and $i\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, the index corresponding to $(i,\mathrm{left})$ under the canonical identification of the disjoint union of sets of sizes $k$ and $m$ with a set of size $k+m$ belongs to the coalition of the first $k$ indices.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in a set of size $k$
